recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future FormularyItem content changes should be made in the PHX incubator IG unless Pharmacy and FMG make a new decision to restore FormularyItem to active core.
issue_request: FHIR-51149 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 Pharmacy change request to expand FormularyItem with the formulary-based elements from MedicationKnowledge, as a consequence of FHIR-50845. The Jira resolution states that FormularyItem was expanded to include all MedicationKnowledge elements that are formulary-based.
initial_application: Commit c07ddd6f87f8e5aa096b645f2a7d976dd8d60df7, titled "Update formulary item with additional elements from MedicationKnowledge," expanded source/formularyitem/structuredefinition-FormularyItem.xml and updated the example. Pharmacy's 2025-09-29 meeting notes record FHIR-51149 as already agreed and applied with an 8-0-0 Frank/Andy vote.
additional_context: FHIR-50845 was the broader parent decision to remove MedicationKnowledge and move applicable content to FormularyItem or other resources, but it remains Resolved - change required and was not independently decided here. Later core history removed FormularyItem from active fhir.ini registration, and FHIR-53486 updated the Medications module so FormularyItem is listed as an external Additional Resource linked to the PHX incubator IG. The PHX incubator package contains a FormularyItem StructureDefinition with the same 46 differential element ids as the inactive core FormularyItem source.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The reconciliation published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch because the current core build no longer owns FormularyItem as an active resource, and the external PHX incubator artifact already carries the expanded definition requested by the issue.
